CustomField.description: The unit/suite the work order relates to, as a free-text label mirrored read-only from Yardi (e.g. "Suite 120", "Common"). This is NOT a relationship to the Unit__c object - it is an uncontrolled string, may hold non-unit values such as "Common", and no Unit__c record is guaranteed to exist for it. Replaces the former Unit__c field, whose name falsely implied a lookup under ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 3.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Free text as it appears in Yardi, e.g. "Suite 120" or "Common". Not linked to a Unit record - do not expect Unit__r to resolve from this field.
CustomField.label: Unit Label
